name: MCG-03-13-063 (Hubble)
blurb: MCG-03-13-063, an interacting galaxy with a tidal tail, seen by Hubble.
label: mcg0313063-hubble
story: Pulled by an unseen companion, this galaxy trails a long, thin tidal tail of stars and gas. Hubble studied the tail to learn how star clusters form in debris flung out by galaxy encounters.

claims.text: MCG-03-13-063 has an extended, thin tidal tail produced by an unseen companion
MCG-03-13-063 is one of the merging systems in a Hubble study of star clusters in tidal debris
Hubble program 14937 observed MCG-03-13-063 to study star formation in HI-rich tidal tails
